primitives.name: Edge-Based Confidence Gating
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Fire on edge `e = p - q`, never confidence.** Confidence-gating = chalk at -EV.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'e': 'dimensionless edge value', 'p': 'probability of event occurrence', 'q': 'probability of counterfactual outcome'}
primitives.assumptions: Expected value of confidence is negative; no reliance on subjective belief.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When p ≈ q, edge collapses to zero, triggering failure mode.

layer2.mapping: GSI's Bayesian update mechanism uses e as a stopping criterion for confidence propagation; GSE's state transition halts when e < threshold.
layer2.telemetry: Cumulative edge deviation from baseline over time series.

primitives.name: Multi-Metric Performance Validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Four-field substantiation** before any public performance number (coverage, Wilson/CP, CLV, walk-forward).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'coverage': 'dimensionless proportion of data covered', 'Wilson/CP': 'confidence interval estimate', 'CLV': 'cumulative loss variance', 'walk-forward': 'out-of-sample predictive accuracy'}
primitives.assumptions: Public performance requires multi-dimensional validation; single-metric reporting is invalid.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if any field fails to meet minimum thresholds.

layer2.mapping: GSI's validation kernel mirrors this structure in its posterior checks; GSE applies it to model state transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Aggregate score across coverage, Wilson/CP, CLV, and walk-forward metrics.

primitives.name: Pre-Kickoff Honest Commitment
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Glass Ledger pre-kickoff commit** — only non-copyable moat is earlier honest start date.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'commit': 'timestamp of earliest honest start', 'moat': 'non-copyable competitive advantage'}
primitives.assumptions: Commitment must be timestamped and verifiable; copying is prohibited.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If commit is falsified or delayed, integrity is compromised.

layer2.telemetry: Time lag between commit and system activation.

The glass ledger provides a temporal anchor for trust, ensuring that commitment precedes execution.
